title: What do you think of this capsule art?
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
I'm working on a 2d pixelart game that feels like gta online but looks like habbo hotel.  
Everything in the world like buildings, characters, weapons and even animations is generated on the fly using AI! So the players basically live in a huge and live updating canvas, where they can build nearly everything.

The goal is to earn gold (there are lots of different ways. Pick yours!) and then build an empire in the online world to gain even more gold. But be careful! other players might raid your houses and steal some of the gold!

Workflow for this capsule:   
\- 5 input screenshots + logo + app icon given to gpt-image-2 then used nano banana to edit details.

What do you think of the capsule?

Feel free to try it: [https://discord.gg/SVHwPzQG3D](https://discord.gg/SVHwPzQG3D)

comments.author: Hungry_River_9594
comments.body:
Not a fan of it, sorry. People like games that remind them of games they like. The fake pixel art is very off-putting, and reminiscent of AI slop. Definitely get rid of the "cozy" words. The portal is confusing too.  
  
Most of the people who even remember Habbo Hotel grew up in the pixel art era where pixel art was truly art, and this is not that.

If you're targeting kids, they'll either be drawn to Roblox style blockiness or some pixel games like Stardew Valley. This isn't either of those either - the sunglasses guy here doesn't have the appeal of Noob or Bacon, the angles are off, the micro blocks are neither pixel nor block.

It sounds like the game is about building, but the capsule says nothing on that. The capsule frames it as a simple RPG between good vs evil. You can look at other building games and see the angles they use.

Sorry to be harsh, but hope it helps.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Hey, thank you so much! This feedback is super helpful for me and I really appreciate it!

comments.author: Yavga
comments.body: First impression: It could be a game I would want to check out because the art style (cartoon/full of color/retro) definitely appeals to me but there is too much happening, the picture isn't focussed and that clutter scares me off.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Thanks a lot. This is super helpful for me!

comments.author: driftwhentired
comments.body: Tells nothing about the game. Just more boring AI art

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body: This is more voxel than pixel. I'd be very careful and make sure you have a very compelling reason to use voxel style art if you do so. It turns a lot of people off unless it can tug on their nostalgia and it's just extremely hard to do well. If it's not essential to the function of your game, consider moving to proper pixel rather than voxel. Also if you're going for Roblox, you're going to want to build inside Roblox. The Roblox aesthetic doesn't really seem to have any traction outside of its insular community.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
The knight guy in the back has an extra blade sticking out from his sword

The background is not in pixel style too

For a better background, you can probably use your game's actual graphics for background too

The art doesn't say anything besides "voxel rpg". If that's all you want to convey, that's fine I suppose
